objective: Integrate the Revision 7 target-parity Wall-OSS engine package as a first-class persistent pi.cpp backend and prove runtime correctness, same-model AGX latency, server/client stability, and closed-loop quality.
non_goals: Do not execute this contract before Revision 7 target engine feasibility passes.
Do not rebuild, alter, or silently replace the frozen Revision 7 engines.
Do not add a PyTorch, ORT, Python, reduced-step, or alternate-model production fallback.
Do not claim deployment success before final400 and human promotion review.
inputs: A passed Revision 7 engine-feasibility decision and frozen engine hashes
The frozen Wall-OSS two-camera BF16 D10 36-layer KV contract
The existing explicit pi.cpp backend, CLI, policy and server patterns
outputs: Persistent C++ TensorRT runner and Python binding
First-class walloss CLI, eval, latency, policy, server/client and TUI integration
Final accept or reject report and rollback path

interfaces.input: Prepared named fixed-shape tensors and immutable Revision 7 engine package.
interfaces.output: Persistent single-inflight TensorRT runner returning float32 [32,26] plus stage timings.
interfaces.change_control: Any tensor ABI, dtype, scheduling, flow, cache, normalization, concurrency or output change requires a contract revision.

interfaces.input: Named face_view/right_wrist_view images, 26-D state, prompt, request ID and explicit x0 or noise seed.
interfaces.output: Float32 [32,26] action chunk and separate policy, preprocessing, stage and request timing metadata.
interfaces.change_control: No silent camera remap, action projection, fallback, truncation, random-noise ambiguity or timing-boundary change is allowed.

work_packages.goal: Freeze runtime interfaces, latency thresholds, port/process ownership and closed-loop protocol.
Implement fixed-contract persistent TensorRT stage loading, buffers, 72 KV handoff, nine-step postfix loop and timing.
Add explicit Wall-OSS wrapper, policy, CLI/eval/latency/server/client/TUI dispatch without a parallel registry.
Build the code against target dependencies and run engine smoke, offline parity, same-model R0 and formal/detailed latency without rebuilding engines.
inputs: Frozen engines, runtime code and explicit AGX runtime approval

work_packages.goal: Run a task-owned persistent service on an approved unused port and prove repeated/reset/memory/timing behavior.
Run the separately approved closed-loop smoke, Gate40 and final400 with frozen episode contracts.
inputs: Accepted persistent candidate and rung approvals

work_packages.goal: Produce a report at success or any early-rejection boundary with exact evidence, risks and rollback.

integration_owner: primary Codex agent under human acceptance gates

safety: Never modify or replace existing accepted backend packages or services.
Use only fresh AGX NVMe directories for builds, logs and runtime packages.
Start only a task-owned process on an approved unused port and stop only that process.
Physical/closed-loop execution requires the named rung approval and frozen episode manifest.
constraints.reversibility: The integration is additive; rollback selects the existing binary/backend and stops only the task-owned Wall-OSS service.
constraints.budget: Run expensive latency and closed-loop stages only after all preceding gates pass and target resources are freshly audited.

promotion.rule: Promotion requires all blocking gates and explicit final human acceptance; no default backend or existing service is changed automatically.
